failures: owner never observed the collaborator's saved word edit within 45171 ms (expected the editor to auto-apply "RemoteWelcome" or show a clear in-editor shared-edit prompt). owner word[0]="Welcome" (server="RemoteWelcome"), owner cached word[0]="Welcome", owner review-API requests during the window=0. Root cause: the main workspace editor does not construct a CollaborationClient (only /edit/ openers do, src/renderer/src/components/EditPage.tsx:12-21); the sole owner ingress is Share -> "Bring shared edits into this project".
